relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: a cumulative dosage of PTX (8 mg/kg) upregulated TRPV1 expression in the lumbar DRG and spinal dorsal horn (SDH) at day 14 post treatment

relationships.subject: duloxetine
relationships.evidence_quote: DUL (20 mg/kg/day) for 5 days markedly ameliorated PTX-induced TRPV1, CGRP, and SP upregulation in the DRG and SDH

relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: upregulated spinal tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) but not IL-1β or IL-10 expression

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: the pharmacological blockade of TRPV1 resulted in an analgesic effect on PTX-induced hyperalgesia

key_findings: Paclitaxel upregulates TRPV1, CGRP and SP in DRG and spinal dorsal horn; duloxetine reverses this and reduces glia activation and TNF-alpha.
